notes: Mahlasedi Public Clinic opens Monday to Friday at 07:30 and closes at 16:00. It is closed on weekends and public holidays. Bring your identity document or birth certificate, clinic card, and any referral letter. Bring a list of medicines you take and your appointment card if you have one. Chronic medicines are collected on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 09:00 to 12:00 at window 3. Parents bringing babies must bring the Road to Health baby booklet and spare nappies. For X-rays, first register at reception, then queue outside room 6 in the east passage with your referral letter. Drinking water is available near reception.
